CustomField.description: BRME-6797 - This formula field created the full path for foundation code. It helps in sorting list view by full path.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Type__c , 'Focus Area Misc'), Level_1__c+'(z)', Level_1__c)+IF(ISBLANK(Level_2__c), Level_2__c, '->'+Level_2__c)+IF(ISBLANK(Level_3__c), Level_3__c, '->'+Level_3__c)+IF(ISBLANK(Level_4__c), Level_4__c, '->'+Level_4__c)+IF(ISBLANK(Level_5__c), Level_5__c, '->'+Level_5__c)
CustomField.label: Full Path Calculated
